primary_source.citation: Wang X, Wang Z, Pan J, et al. Patterns of Extrathoracic Metastases in Different Histological Types of Lung Cancer. Front Oncol. 2020;10:715.
primary_source.study_type: Population-based SEER analysis; n=159,241 lung cancer patients diagnosed 2010-2014

biomarkers.name: EGFR
biomarkers.prevalence: ~15% US/EU unselected; ~30-50% East Asian, never-smokers, female
biomarkers.clinical_use: Classical mutations (ex19del ~45%, L858R ~40%): first-line osimertinib. Adjuvant osimertinib post-resection (ADAURA). Atypical mutations (G719X, L861Q, S768I) — afatinib. Exon 20 insertions — amivantamab

biomarkers.name: EGFR T790M
biomarkers.clinical_use: Osimertinib for T790M-positive disease after progression on earlier-generation EGFR TKIs; as osimertinib is now commonly used first-line, acquired T790M is mainly of historical/selected sequencing relevance rather than a usual post-osimertinib marker

biomarkers.name: ALK fusions (EML4-ALK most common)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Alectinib, brigatinib, lorlatinib first-line. Adjuvant alectinib (ALINA). Higher rate in never-smokers and younger

biomarkers.name: ROS1 fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Entrectinib or crizotinib first-line; repotrectinib for post-progression / CNS disease

biomarkers.name: KRAS non-G12C
biomarkers.clinical_use: No approved targeted therapy; may predict reduced benefit from EGFR-directed therapy

biomarkers.name: MET amplification
biomarkers.prevalence: ~1-5% de novo; higher as acquired resistance to EGFR TKI
biomarkers.clinical_use: Capmatinib has activity in high-level MET-amplified NSCLC; MET-directed combinations with osimertinib are used/investigated in EGFR-mutant post-TKI resistance

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (TPS by 22C3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: TPS ≥50%: pembrolizumab monotherapy first-line. TPS ≥1% and driver-negative: various IO/chemo-IO regimens

biomarkers.name: STK11 / KEAP1 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Negative predictor for immune checkpoint inhibitor benefit; co-occurring with KRAS often

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.clinical_use: Predictive value for immunotherapy is context-dependent; tissue-agnostic pembrolizumab may be used if TMB ≥10 mut/Mb

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Glandular differentiation with mucin production; multiple architectural patterns often coexist within a single tumour
histomorphological_subtype.grading: IASLC 2020 grading system based on dominant pattern + high-grade component (grade 1-3) — replaces older schemes

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Highly variable — from immune-desert (STK11/KEAP1) to inflamed (PD-L1 high, smokers)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Alveolar type II pneumocytes (AT2 cells) and club cells — bronchioalveolar stem/progenitor populations at bronchioalveolar duct junctions have been implicated in some models
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut derivative (lung bud from primitive foregut)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Variable — lepidic pattern retains AT2 differentiation with intact TTF-1 and napsin A expression; solid pattern loses architectural differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: EGFR-mutant adenocarcinomas can undergo lineage switching to small cell (neuroendocrine transformation) after TKI therapy — RB1+TP53 co-loss enables this; squamous transformation also documented
